short: Lightweight, tough components made for life at 35,000 feet and thousands of turnarounds.

meta_description: Injection moulded airline and aerospace parts, including trolley trays, galley drawers and bins. Supplying the largest UK carriers for over 30 years. Ertone Plastics.
overview: Lightweight, durable components engineered for demanding aerospace environments. We produce precision formed and moulded parts for interiors, housings, covers and other applications where strength, consistency and low weight are critical.

We have worked with the largest UK carriers for over 30 years, supplying drawers, trays, bins and many more products. We regularly receive supplier awards for quality and on time service. From prototype development through to repeat production, every component is made with close attention to fit, finish and performance.

overview: Ertone provides plastic injection moulding for construction applications where durability, consistency and supply reliability are essential. We manufacture components used across housing, infrastructure and building systems, supporting customers with high volume production and long term supply programmes.

Our range runs from buckets and trowels to scrapers and mallets, built for harsh conditions on site. UK based production supports both new product introductions and ongoing supply, with consistent quality and dependable lead times.

name: Automation
seo_title: Precision Plastic Parts for Automation | Ertone
short: Small precision parts that keep automated systems running smoothly.
hero_line: Small precision parts that keep automated lines running, batch after batch.
meta_description: Injection moulded precision parts for industrial automation, made to tight tolerances for long life and dependable performance. Ertone Plastics.
overview: Industrial automation relies on high quality plastic parts for precision and reliability. We mould plastic components for the automation industry to a high standard, for a long lifespan and dependable performance. Well made parts keep automated systems running smoothly, cut maintenance and help lines stay on schedule. Small precision parts are our speciality.

Our parts are designed to suit a wide range of automation systems, so integration is simple. We work to tight tolerances and repeatable processes, so every batch matches the last, whether you order a prototype run or full production.

overview: The sports industry depends on components that are lightweight, durable and made to perform consistently. Plastic is used in everything from training equipment and protective products to accessories, fixtures and specialist sporting goods, which makes injection moulding a natural fit.

We make high quality plastic components for the sports sector, helping businesses create dependable products that stand up to repeated use while meeting specific performance and design requirements. With experience across simple and more complex parts, we support projects across a broad range of sporting applications.

overview: Defence applications need components that perform reliably in challenging environments, where strength, consistency and precision are essential. Injection moulded plastics are used across a wide range of defence products and systems, offering a durable, lightweight and versatile option for both specialist and high volume work.

We make plastic components for the defence sector with a strong focus on quality and repeatability. We work to specific material, dimensional and performance requirements, so each part suits its intended use and is produced to a consistently high standard.

meta_description: Plastic serving trays, food containers, tableware and reusable drinkware, including polycarbonate pints and polypropylene flutes, made in the UK by Ertone Plastics.
overview: We make durable, hygienic plastic products for the UK catering and hospitality industry, from serving trays and food containers to tableware and drinkware.

Our reusable drinkware includes polycarbonate pints and polypropylene champagne flutes, and products can be customised with your logo or branding. Used cups and glasses can come back through our closed loop recycling system and be moulded into new products.
